sentences.en: Squad Leader Justin, a blip's appeared on the hyperspace radar!
sentences.zh: 中士简森，超空间雷达上出现了一个光点!

sentences.en: Optical radar uses light, unlike normal radar, which uses radio waves.
sentences.zh: 光学雷达使用的是光线，而不是通常使用的无线电波。

sentences.en: A lot of radars are installed along the street.
sentences.zh: 街道两侧安装了很多雷达。

senses.zh: 雷达，无线电探测器；觉察力，洞察力
